prs.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
prs.author: Genmin
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts rejects POST requests whose Accept header lists only `application/json` — the handler currently requires both `application/json` AND `text/event-stream` to be present, which incorrectly rejects valid JSON-only clients. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts rejects POST requests whose Accept header lists only `application/json` — the handler currently requires both `application/json` AND `text/event-stream` to be present, which incorrectly rejects valid JSON-only clients. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 adds a dedicated `acceptsMediaType` parser that correctly handles Accept header semantics per RFC 7231: it splits on `;` to strip parameters, honors `q=0` as an explicit exclusion, and supports type/subtype wildcard matching (e.g. `*/*`, `application/*`). #2046 fixes the same bug with a plain `acceptHeader.includes('application/json')` substring check — it doesn't parse q-values (so `application/json;q=0` would incorrectly still match) and doesn't handle wildcards, making it a narrower fix for the same underlying issue.
